**Myrkl** is ` [Highlight start] a pre-drinking dietary supplement designed to help moderate drinkers feel more refreshed the morning after socializing [Highlight end] ` . Developed by de Faire Medical, it uses a patented formula called AB001 that combines probiotic bacteria (*Bacillus subtilis* and *Bacillus coagulans* ), L-cysteine, vitamin B12, and fermented rice bran.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESTQHEIkXX59_4zGWEr3tcdL5LXnUeDJm7kyvfuEftkqWNCyKVggjnJA7zGJBVW5JmdktH9TIw6dAXnDuOp6__Dp29qgu1p81irBgJ_QGz)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsQEBxCJF10cAPEOoEdaTdWw_BQPNMzW429DqpryXABmKGlkRyrbgy4OIESS3qK3EgxlXu9MCOf6nULXi50Zi8mY652PXg3Tz8ZhtF8zz3gQXBlqs3cK04ZFxAF5PCfavlmQliLQo6fO5JGxDEp19KMx6Ye-tX-f0ec-X3d_AxEzM1zXG5aJqXHSMSZ_c6ZmwFA9AnxGTY7PH0N1BSFqXI11_RgtfP5I0wux1gemx3PZCnRI)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESTAHEIkXX6tjHPdmCj0ckN_YxMA_Ilpd7O-rGAGGbH6KrV3cO6HMEAzl_u_w2Pvi8O23U6Y8t8WsBt4kbQOl4bUU6VJsNCZy0D5-1fms)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF16M1vSUDpQLGcQunUADM4wH1XvgPAQolXT9gyMmRNEBVTRvUOL6DYvIiHb8l86rOkqWvEWiooYCX69Od8Tn1kKXBNyN4cAcsSg4Iy89Pei_bHw8V152aREy9PkOA58FprahE7pgXobzK7mPyMWbfUqaa9SGBCnUNCOx0F3Ez)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXZncq-KCxBtTE5K0ts4tK8xNssUXVzYc46dim0tSKE6TJISHKXgflk1V4e00k6XkYqntoSbMdTqd9HgKIZHAlG06syyyNsxTzKUU89jm8UgpzaWAPC3vVxQSPiSXeMjWtTw)

### How It Works & Usage

- **Timing & Dose:** The recommended serving is two capsules taken about two hours before drinking alcohol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXZncq-KCxBtTE5K0ts4tK8xNssUXVzYc46dim0tSKE6TJISHKXgflk1V4e00k6XkYqntoSbMdTqd9HgKIZHAlG06syyyNsxTzKUU89jm8UgpzaWAPC3vVxQSPiSXeMjWtTw)
- **Mechanism:** Acid-resistant capsules aim to activate bacteria in the gut to break down some alcohol before it reaches the liver and enters the bloodstream, while vitamin B12 supports normal energy levels and helps reduce tiredness. You can learn more about its formulation directly from [Myrkl](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESTQHEIkXX59_4zGWEr3tcdL5LXnUeDJm7kyvfuEftkqWNCyKVggjnJA7zGJBVW5JmdktH9TIw6dAXnDuOp6__Dp29qgu1p81irBgJ_QGz).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESTQHEIkXX59_4zGWEr3tcdL5LXnUeDJm7kyvfuEftkqWNCyKVggjnJA7zGJBVW5JmdktH9TIw6dAXnDuOp6__Dp29qgu1p81irBgJ_QGz)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF16M1vSUDpQLGcQunUADM4wH1XvgPAQolXT9gyMmRNEBVTRvUOL6DYvIiHb8l86rOkqWvEWiooYCX69Od8Tn1kKXBNyN4cAcsSg4Iy89Pei_bHw8V152aREy9PkOA58FprahE7pgXobzK7mPyMWbfUqaa9SGBCnUNCOx0F3Ez)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXGFEQ7OKpU-8UPV4N6IyrgCuanDD0H5-nkHjr-kbxO4sSuXUQjkvDskDd6YR0j5UmW-7YHhprjLv-UaI2hXbO3sPMR2qeQ_dy4IMhnXB7KTkR279DCH6y02oCnVm2fcrdQ3ZEcX4A)

### Effectiveness & Limitations

- **Evidence:** According to Healthline, Myrkl's claims—including breaking down up to 70% of alcohol in 60 minutes—are based on a small study of 24 subjects, and health experts note evidence on preventing hangovers remains limited.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF16M1vSUDpQLGcQunUADM4wH1XvgPAQolXT9gyMmRNEBVTRvUOL6DYvIiHb8l86rOkqWvEWiooYCX69Od8Tn1kKXBNyN4cAcsSg4Iy89Pei_bHw8V152aREy9PkOA58FprahE7pgXobzK7mPyMWbfUqaa9SGBCnUNCOx0F3Ez)
- **User & Expert Perspectives:** Consumer reviews on Trustpilot and independent write-ups like *All But Drams* report mixed-to-positive experiences with next-day clarity and milder headaches, though fatigue or other hangover symptoms can still happen.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXZncq-KCxBtTE5K0ts4tK8xNssUXVzYc46dim0tSKE6TJISHKXgflk1V4e00k6XkYqntoSbMdTqd9HgKIZHAlG06syyyNsxTzKUU89jm8UgpzaWAPC3vVxQSPiSXeMjWtTw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXaYRKOcx_QJ1LQL5t-0j5ctd3jDD0EwBkwD21dhSooXf3FTR5AQjtxSmFCh4cxCzdVn-SEpiYyoRYWQdOGajHTnVhuiMeGDTTB5gbvxTSOXYhIC6KtuOGyUPZB_8LjVkPqFZIW5l9VfhrD5uBRHgY3oF2KQ)
- **Health Caveats:** Health organizations and outlets such as *Healthcare Digital* caution that supplements do not eliminate alcohol's broader health risks, and feeling less intoxicated could unintentionally encourage heavier drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsQEBxCJF10cAPEOoEdaTdWw_BQPNMzW429DqpryXABmKGlkRyrbgy4OIESS3qK3EgxlXu9MCOf6nULXi50Zi8mY652PXg3Tz8ZhtF8zz3gQXBlqs3cK04ZFxAF5PCfavlmQliLQo6fO5JGxDEp19KMx6Ye-tX-f0ec-X3d_AxEzM1zXG5aJqXHSMSZ_c6ZmwFA9AnxGTY7PH0N1BSFqXI11_RgtfP5I0wux1gemx3PZCnRI)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXaYRKOcx_QJ1LQL5t-0j5ctd3jDD0EwBkwD21dhSooXf3FTR5AQjtxSmFCh4cxCzdVn-SEpiYyoRYWQdOGajHTnVhuiMeGDTTB5gbvxTSOXYhIC6KtuOGyUPZB_8LjVkPqFZIW5l9VfhrD5uBRHgY3oF2KQ)
